title: Day-crew note
body: A sticky note on the monitor, in someone else's handwriting: "The night operator seems... familiar." You have been here one shift.

outcome.text: You put a mug on it so it doesn't blow away. There is no draft.

choices.label: Peel it off. Keep it in the logbook.

outcome.text: The adhesive takes a little of the monitor with it. The logbook is heavier by one sentence.
